title: Reading Drill — Viewing a Dress without Touching It
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Viewing a Dress without Touching It
passages.body:
**A** A museum wanted visitors to see the lining of a fragile dress. The conservator could not leave it unfolded for long, so she took a detailed photograph before it was mounted.

**B** The photograph showed colour and fabric but could not reveal how the folds opened. A student made a small replica to demonstrate the movement with robust material.

**C** The label distinguished features copied from the original from features simplified for handling. The replica could be removed from its stand for a guided session.
